title: Blackstone Real Estate Income Trust, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-23
summary: Blackstone Real Estate Income Trust (BREIT) filed a Form 8-K on April 22, 2026, announcing preliminary estimated Q1 2026 same property net operating income (NOI) increased approximately 3% year-over-year. The filing reports estimated net loss of $375,804 thousand for Q1 2026 versus actual net loss of $395,076 thousand in Q1 2025. The filing explicitly states this data is preliminary, unaudited, and not a comprehensive statement of financial results.
key_points: BREIT announced preliminary estimated same property NOI for Q1 2026 increased approximately 3% year-over-year (midpoint of estimated range)
Estimated Q1 2026 net loss: $375,804 thousand (versus Q1 2025 actual net loss of $395,076 thousand)
The filing explicitly warns actual results may differ materially from preliminary estimates
Deloitte & Touche LLP has not audited, reviewed, compiled or performed any procedures on this preliminary financial data
Q1 2025 actual net loss included adjustments of $(1,839,784) thousand to reconcile to same property NOI basis
The company defines NOI as operating revenues less operating expenses, excluding depreciation, amortization, impairments, and various corporate-level costs
